# Particles

A quiet constellation gives the interface room to breathe.

## Use

Use for technology explainers, discovery pages, and ambient learning hubs.

## Essential traits

- Sparse background particles
- Large quiet reading zones
- Optional slow ambient motion

## Typography

System sans-serif with open heading spacing.

## Layout and surfaces

Stable foreground panels over a sparse constellation. Small decorative dots and fine connecting lines behind opaque panels.

## Palette

- background: #0a1630
- surface: #122747
- text: #edf5ff
- muted: #b5cbe3
- accent: #a2d5ff
- border: #4d6d91

## Copy-ready prompt

```text

Stable foreground panels over a sparse constellation. Small decorative dots and fine connecting lines behind opaque panels. Palette: background #0a1630, surface #122747, text #edf5ff, muted #b5cbe3, accent #a2d5ff, border #4d6d91. Essential traits: Sparse background particles; Large quiet reading zones; Optional slow ambient motion. Avoid: Particles over text; Distracting density; Random movement required for navigation. Keep motion restrained and optional, respect reduced motion, and provide a static fallback. Adapt the appearance to the requested output format. Keep text legible, controls accessible, and content editable where supported. Resolve mandatory brand conflicts explicitly. Return the design and accurately report performed and unperformed checks.
```

## Validation

Available style specification. Check the actual output; no blanket accessibility or visual-fidelity certification is claimed.
